class.name: VoxelBlockRegistry
class.brief_description: Resource that assigns textures and optional shaders to engine-defined block types for [VoxelWorld].
class.description: A registry used by [VoxelWorld]. Each block type is defined at the engine level (in VoxelBlockData) with its name, color, solidity, and transparency. This resource allows assigning per-face textures (top, side, bottom) and an optional [ShaderMaterial] to those block types from the editor. When a block has a [ShaderMaterial] assigned, all its faces are rendered with that shader instead of the default [StandardMaterial3D]. The block's primary texture is automatically set as the [code]texture_albedo[/code] shader parameter. Shader authors should declare [code]uniform sampler2D texture_albedo;[/code] in their [code].gdshader[/code] file to receive the block texture. When no registry is assigned to a [VoxelWorld], one is created automatically with entries for all built-in block types (no textures or shaders assigned, vertex colors used).

method.name: create_block
method.description: Creates a new texture entry for the given block ID. Does nothing if the entry already exists.

method.name: remove_block
method.description: Removes the texture entry for the given block ID.

method.name: has_block
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a texture entry with the given block ID exists.

method.name: get_block_list
method.description: Returns an array of all registered block IDs.

method.name: get_block_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered block entries.

method.name: set_block_texture_top
method.description: Sets the texture for the top face (+Y) of the block.

method.name: get_block_texture_top
method.description: Returns the texture assigned to the top face of the block.

method.name: set_block_texture_side
method.description: Sets the texture for the side faces of the block.

method.name: get_block_texture_side
method.description: Returns the texture assigned to the side faces of the block.

method.name: set_block_texture_bottom
method.description: Sets the texture for the bottom face (-Y) of the block.

method.name: get_block_texture_bottom
method.description: Returns the texture assigned to the bottom face of the block.

method.name: block_has_texture
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the block has any texture assigned (top, side, or bottom).

method.name: setup_defaults
method.description: Populates the registry with entries for all built-in block types (Air, Grass, Dirt, Stone, Sand, Water, Snow, Wood, Leaves, Bedrock). No textures are assigned; blocks will use engine-defined vertex colors by default.

method.name: set_block_shader_material
method.description: Sets the [ShaderMaterial] for the block. When set, all faces of this block type are rendered with this shader instead of the default material. The block's primary texture is automatically passed as the [code]texture_albedo[/code] shader parameter.

method.name: get_block_shader_material
method.description: Returns the [ShaderMaterial] assigned to the block, or [code]null[/code] if none is set.

method.name: block_has_shader
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the block has a [ShaderMaterial] assigned.

method.name: set_block_breakable
method.description: Sets whether the block can ever be destroyed. When [code]false[/code] the block is indestructible (e.g. bedrock) and [method get_block_break_time_for_tool] always returns [code]-1.0[/code].

method.name: get_block_breakable
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the block can be destroyed.

method.name: set_block_requires_tool
method.description: Sets whether the block requires a matching tool entry to be broken. When [code]true[/code] and no tool entry matches, [method get_block_break_time_for_tool] returns [code]-1.0[/code] (cannot be broken by hand or with a mismatched tool). When [code]false[/code] and no matching tool entry exists, the block can still be broken by hand in [method get_block_hand_break_time] seconds.

method.name: get_block_requires_tool
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a matching tool is required to break the block.

method.name: set_block_hand_break_time
method.description: Sets the base break time in seconds when no matching tool entry is found and [method get_block_requires_tool] is [code]false[/code]. This is the time it takes to break the block by hand or with a wrong tool type.

method.name: get_block_hand_break_time
method.description: Returns the block's hand break time in seconds.

method.name: add_block_tool_entry
method.description: Adds a tool entry for the block defining how long it takes to break with a specific tool type and tier. [param tool_type] is a soft string reference (e.g. [code]"pickaxe"[/code], [code]"shovel"[/code]); pass an empty [StringName] to match any tool type. [param min_tier] is the minimum integer tool tier required for this entry to apply. [param break_time] is the duration in seconds. Returns the index of the new entry. Multiple entries for the same tool type with different [param min_tier] values form a tier table: the entry with the highest [param min_tier] that is still [code]<=[/code] the player's tool tier is used.

method.name: remove_block_tool_entry
method.description: Removes the tool entry at [param entry_idx] from the block's tool entry list.

method.name: get_block_tool_entry_count
method.description: Returns the number of tool entries registered for the block.

method.name: get_block_tool_entries
method.description: Returns all tool entries for the block as an [Array] of [Dictionary] values. Each dictionary has the keys [code]"tool_type"[/code] ([String]), [code]"min_tier"[/code] ([int]), and [code]"break_time"[/code] ([float]).

method.name: get_block_break_time_for_tool
method.description: Returns the break time in seconds for the given tool type and tier, or [code]-1.0[/code] if the block cannot be broken with that combination. Matching rules: 1. If the block is not breakable ([method get_block_breakable] is [code]false[/code]), always returns [code]-1.0[/code]. 2. Searches tool entries for the best match: [code]tool_type[/code] equals [param tool_type] (or entry's [code]tool_type[/code] is empty = wildcard) [b]and[/b] entry's [code]min_tier[/code] is [code]<=[/code] [param tool_tier]. Among all matches the entry with the highest [code]min_tier[/code] is used. 3. If no entry matches and [method get_block_requires_tool] is [code]true[/code], returns [code]-1.0[/code]. 4. If no entry matches and [method get_block_requires_tool] is [code]false[/code], returns [method get_block_hand_break_time]. [b]Example GDScript usage:[/b] [codeblock] var time = registry.get_block_break_time_for_tool(STONE, &"pickaxe", player_tool_tier) if time < 0: return # Cannot break with this tool # Wait 'time' seconds, then remove block and calculate drops [/codeblock]
